title: Team, Support & Operations
description: Call Intelligence, support tickets, Shvya Vault, teams, MCP and secure operations.

pages.title: Call Intelligence workspace
pages.summary: Link supported call activity to CRM leads, outcomes, analytics and follow-ups.
pages.body:
## What Call Intelligence does
Call Intelligence records permitted call events and links them to SHVYA CRM. The currently supported mobile companion is **Android**, using SIM-based call information and authorized device permissions. It is not an iOS recorder or a guarantee that every device can capture audio.

## Use the workspace
1. Open [Call Intelligence](/dashboard/call-intelligence/).
2. Review recent calls, filters, employee activity, dispositions and call detail.
3. Connect and authorize the Android companion if you intend to sync supported call logs.
4. Inspect matched CRM leads and attach unmatched numbers to a valid lead where authorized.
5. Add notes, dispositions and follow-up actions and review available analysis.

## What the system stores
Call identity, source, timestamps, phone, permitted duration and outcome, linked CRM lead/call, selected notes and follow-up. Where available and authorized, a recording, transcript, AI analysis, intent and other derived fields can be associated with a call.

## Accurate interpretation
**Answered rate** and **call conversion** are call-outcome metrics, not unique sales revenue. An unanalyzed call should not be shown as a zero AI score. Manual CRM **Mark call** entries differ from Android-synchronized events.

## Troubleshooting
Check device permissions, heartbeat, login, owned pipeline access, last sync time, number normalization and whether the call was already imported. A successful app install is not evidence of successful data synchronization.

[Android companion](/docs/operations/android-app/) · [CRM calls and reminders](/docs/crm-leads/reminders-calls/).

pages.title: Android Call Intelligence companion
pages.summary: Install and troubleshoot the supported SHVYA call tracking APK.
pages.body:
## Install
1. Open [Call Intelligence](/dashboard/call-intelligence/) on an authorized desktop or Android browser.
2. Use the currently available **Download Android** control for the approved APK.
3. Install only from the official SHVYA application workflow authorized by your organization.
4. Log in to your organization account and grant the Android call-log/phone permissions actually required by the app.
5. Confirm the device appears under the Call Intelligence devices/account area.
6. Place an authorized test call and verify its outcome reaches SHVYA.

## Device-to-CRM flow
The Android companion synchronizes call events from supported phone APIs. SHVYA validates the device owner and tenant, links matched phones to existing leads and creates allowed new leads under configured routing. The employee's pipeline assignment still controls which leads they may create/manage.

## If no calls sync
- Verify Android version and granted phone/call-log permissions.
- Check account sign-in, app network access, background battery restrictions and device heartbeat.
- Inspect the most recent successful sync; compare it to the test call time.
- Check whether the phone already matches an existing lead in another permitted pipeline.
- Refresh device/session status only after checking pending uploads.

## Privacy
Call records can contain sensitive customer information. Follow local laws, workplace policy and consent for recording or transcription. The app cannot be assumed to secretly capture all conversations.

## What is not promised
No iOS companion is documented. Automatic full call recording, universally available transcripts and uninterrupted background capture are not guaranteed across all devices.

[Call Intelligence](/docs/operations/call-intelligence/) · [Support tickets](/docs/operations/support-tickets/).

pages.title: Help & Support tickets
pages.summary: Report product issues and follow your case in SHVYA's organization portal.
pages.body:
## Where to get help
Open [Help & Support](/dashboard/support-portal/) while signed into your SHVYA organization. This customer portal and the internal Shvya-Ops staff console operate on the same ticket records.

## Create a good ticket
1. Choose the most relevant category and issue.
2. Use a focused subject such as “Hosted WhatsApp QR keeps expiring”.
3. Describe what you expected, what happened and when it started.
4. Include your organization, module, safe lead/account reference, relevant timestamp/timezone and error code.
5. Attach a redacted screenshot or allowed document if it helps reproduce the problem.
6. Submit once; keep the ticket reference for follow-up.

## Continue a conversation
Use the ticket detail to view public Shvya-Ops replies and respond with additional evidence. Internal Shvya-Ops notes are not shown to customers. Ticket status and the “response required” indicator reflect the actual latest public reply, not just whether you opened the page.

## Security and visibility
Ticket access follows organization support policy. Some teams may view organization tickets while ordinary users in a restricted organization may be limited to tickets they personally created. Shared ticket links, when available, have bounded access and can expire or be revoked.

## Information not to include
Never provide passwords, one-time codes, raw API keys, Meta app secrets, full private webhook URLs or private customer records unrelated to the issue.

[Support escalation checklist](/docs/troubleshooting/support-escalation/) · [First diagnostics](/docs/troubleshooting/first-checks/).

pages.title: Shvya-Ops staff operations
pages.summary: Understand how authorized platform support handles tickets and private account diagnostics.
pages.body:
## Customer and staff separation
Customers use [Help & Support](/dashboard/support-portal/). Authorized platform staff use **Superadmin → Client's Portal** at /superadmin/client-portal/ to manage cases across authorized organizations.

## Staff capabilities
Depending on platform roles and configuration, Shvya-Ops staff can triage tickets, use statuses and priority, assign staff, post public replies, add **internal-only notes**, manage private attachments and maintain related work items.

## When contacting support
A complete reproduction often needs the affected organization, module, account/lead reference, provider message ID, time, observed state and safe logs. Staff should first compare actual stored state with provider outcome before attempting a retry.

## Privacy
A platform support context does not mean an external AI client or a customer can read every organization's data. Staff-only notes, mailbox credentials, attachment storage references and other tenants' records are protected.

## Response indicator
The customer portal's response-needed state is derived from the last committed public message while a ticket remains open. Opening a ticket without answering does not dismiss a pending request.

## Resolution checklist
Before closing a case, verify the actual customer-visible result—message arrived, lead was created, booking was saved or PDF was delivered—not just that a setting was changed.

[Customer tickets](/docs/operations/support-tickets/) · [Debugging evidence](/docs/troubleshooting/support-escalation/).

pages.title: External AI / Operations MCP
pages.summary: Connect authorized AI assistants to scoped SHVYA diagnostic and operation capabilities.
pages.body:
## What is Operations MCP?
SHVYA exposes an OAuth-protected **Operations MCP** endpoint for approved external AI clients and a separate read-only diagnostic connector. An AI assistant can inspect and, when explicitly permitted, propose or apply bounded SHVYA actions through backend tools.

## Authorization matters
- The OAuth login binds the external client to a real SHVYA actor.
- An organization administrator is restricted to their organization and Superadmin-owned policy.
- A Superadmin must select an explicit customer support context before customer-specific operations.
- Write capabilities require the correct scope, active organization policy and, for sensitive actions, applicable approval.
- Loading a Skill or using an AI prompt never grants new privileges.

## Connect a compatible client
1. In your approved AI client, configure the authorized SHVYA MCP address: **https://shvya-ai.com/operations/mcp/**.
2. Authenticate through SHVYA's OAuth browser flow using your own role.
3. Inspect the client-visible tool list and available organization context.
4. Read existing configuration before suggesting a change.
5. For writes, review target IDs, tenant, requested diff and approval prompt.
6. Check the live saved state and validate behavior after applying a change.

## Domain skills
The platform packages domain-focused assistance, including account setup/review, AI flow testing, acceptance testing, workflow building, WhatsApp diagnostics and account handover. These are instructions for combining authorized tools, not hidden master keys.

## Troubleshoot connection
Check OAuth session/PKCE completion, client permissions, current support context, revoked grants and organization capability policy. Do not paste access tokens or refresh credentials into chats or tickets.

[SHVYA API](/docs/connect-hub/shvya-api/) · [Security](/docs/operations/security-privacy/).

pages.title: SHVYA Vault
pages.summary: Collect client business knowledge for review before account setup.
pages.body:
## What Vault is
SHVYA Vault is an organization-specific private information-gathering workspace administered through **Superadmin → Vault**. Staff may share a private Vault URL and access code so a business can supply materials without a CRM user login.

## What clients provide
The sections can collect website pages, brochures and price lists, media, products/services, business basics, FAQs, employee handoff information, qualification questions, sales scripts, links and answers to outstanding setup questions.

## Typical process
1. Authorized SHVYA staff create or open the organization's Vault.
2. Staff securely share the private access link and code with the correct client.
3. The client adds links, files, notes and answers in the right sections.
4. Staff review accuracy and can generate a draft profile/configuration proposal.
5. An authorized person separately applies verified content to AI Brain, FAQ, knowledge or channel configuration.
6. The live account is tested before handover.

## Crucial distinction
**Vault submission is not a live AI Brain update.** A new file or answer in Vault does not automatically change model prompts, publish a brochure, route a lead or send a WhatsApp message. The review/application step preserves accountability.

## Security
Vault links and codes are private. They grant access to the intended content intake, not to another organization's CRM or the main SHVYA dashboard. Revoke or rotate compromised access through authorized staff.

[AI Brain](/docs/ai-automation/ai-brain/) · [Account quickstart](/docs/getting-started/quickstart/).

pages.title: Teams and pipeline ownership
pages.summary: Give colleagues appropriate access without losing lead confidentiality.
pages.body:
## Set up your team
1. Open the **Teams** workspace as an authorized organization admin.
2. Invite or add team members through the current product flow.
3. Assign an appropriate role and the pipelines they need.
4. Enable only the stage, lead and task permissions needed for their job.
5. Test a team member's view to ensure they can see their own leads but not unauthorized organization records.

## Understand ownership
Lead routing, connected sender identity and pipeline permissions interact. An employee's access to a pipeline does not automatically connect a new WhatsApp number. Similarly, a device-synchronized call can match an existing lead that the employee may not otherwise be permitted to edit.

## Common access problems
- Agent cannot open a lead: pipeline is not assigned.
- Bulk move blocked: permission may be required on **both** source and target pipelines.
- New call-created lead fails: employee may lack an active assigned destination pipeline.
- Admin-only integration hidden: the user's role is not authorized to manage external provider credentials.

## Best practices
Review permissions when employees move teams, revoke inactive users promptly and avoid sharing one account login between team members.

[Permissions](/docs/getting-started/roles-permissions/) · [CRM routing](/docs/crm-leads/pipelines-stages/).

pages.title: Security, privacy and account safety
pages.summary: Understand organization isolation, provider credentials and sensitive customer data.
pages.body:
## Organization isolation
SHVYA's CRM, channel messages, configuration, documents, call data, support tickets and connected services use organization-scoped identities and server-side access checks. A customer-supplied organization ID is not permission to read or mutate that organization's records.

## Protect credentials
- Keep Meta, Google, email, payment gateway and SHVYA API credentials in approved secret storage.
- Treat private webhook URLs as bearer secrets; rotate when exposed.
- Do not place passwords, OTPs or full authorization headers in screenshots or support replies.
- Revoke former employees' or contractors' access promptly.
- Confirm customer consent and provider policy before sending outbound messages.

## Handle documents responsibly
Only upload content your organization has permission to store and share. Keep confidential internal files out of AI-Guided File Sharing. Verify that support attachments, sales documents, Vault records and Calendar files are accessed through their intended authorized views.

## AI boundaries
The Playbook and knowledge files can inform replies, but cannot authorize cross-tenant access or bypass provider messaging rules. An external AI MCP connection is still bounded by user identity, scope, organization and approval.

## Incident response
If a key, webhook URL or linked session is compromised, revoke/rotate it, review the corresponding connection and open a priority support ticket with redacted evidence. Do not ask support to disable security validation as a workaround.

[Support](/docs/operations/support-tickets/) · [Operations MCP](/docs/operations/mcp-operations/).
